# Clean & Clear Plus


## Engineered for performance. Designed for service. Crystal clear results.


-


### Smart & Sustainable


Equipment that is easy to use, reliable and durable, able to operate efficiently continuously and autonomously, saves resources (energy, water, products) and has a low environmental impact (life cycle of the swimming pool).


-


-


### Tradegrade


-


### PIP Product


Elegible product for points on the Partners Incentive Program for professionals.


Introducing the next generation of Clean & Clear Plus — combining the proven performance of a four-cartridge filtration system with two major innovations: integrated Pleatco Ultra technology and a redesigned clamp system engineered for simpler, faster service operations.


Designed to maximize filtration efficiency and ease of maintenance, Clean & Clear Plus[equipped with Pleatco Ultra cartridge](https://www.pentairpooleurope.com/products/filters/pleatco) , delivers superior dirt capture, extended cleaning cycles and long-term reliability — ensuring consistently crystal-clear water and a better overall pool experience.


### Technical specifications


- Single-piece base and tank: Fiberglass-reinforced polypropylene provides strength, corrosion resistance and stability.
- 63 mm plumbing: For maximum flow and faster water cleaning.
- 4-Pleatco cartridge design: Enhanced dirt capture, longer filtration cycles and consistently crystal-clear water.
- Internal air bleed: Continuous internal air bleed helps prevent air buildup to keep the filter operating at peak performance.
- Simplified Cast Clamp: Allows a simplified and secured access to internal parts.


-


## Features & Benefits


-


### Superior Filtration Performance


4-cartridge design for increased filtration area. Now equipped with Pleatco Ultra technology


-


### Simplified Serviceability


New cast clamp with step-by-step guidance. Easy access for cartridge cleaning


-


### Durable & Stable Design


Corrosion-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced tank. Single-piece base and body construction
